# shopify Provider

Manages Shopify store configuration through the Admin GraphQL API. Authenticate with `client_id` and `client_secret` (client credentials grant, preferred) or a static `access_token`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Credentials are usually set via SHOPIFY_STORE_DOMAIN, SHOPIFY_CLIENT_ID and SHOPIFY_CLIENT_SECRET.
provider "shopify" {
  store_domain  = "example.myshopify.com"
  client_id     = var.shopify_client_id
  client_secret = var.shopify_client_secret
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `access_token` (String, Sensitive) Static Admin API access token, instead of client credentials. Env: `SHOPIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN`.
- `api_version` (String) Admin API version. Defaults to `2026-10`, the version the provider is built against.
- `client_id` (String, Sensitive) Client ID of the Dev Dashboard app. Env: `SHOPIFY_CLIENT_ID`.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Client secret of the Dev Dashboard app. Env: `SHOPIFY_CLIENT_SECRET`.
- `concurrency` (Number) Maximum in-flight API requests, regardless of Terraform parallelism. Defaults to `2`.
- `max_retries` (Number) Retries for throttled and 429/5xx responses. Defaults to `5`.
- `store_domain` (String) Store domain, `<handle>.myshopify.com` (not a custom domain). Env: `SHOPIFY_STORE_DOMAIN`.
